description: This PHP source file defines the 'I18NImportErrorAPI' class within the 'OrangeHRM' project. It implements an API endpoint for listing internationalization (i18n) import errors, with support for sorting, pagination, and filtering. The class extends a base Endpoint and implements a CollectionEndpoint, utilizing traits for auth and localization services. It contains methods for fetching data ('getAll') and validation rules, with other CRUD operations not implemented.
